name: notaires-listing
title: Appartement à A vendre 4 pièces (88.25 m²) - RENNES 35000 - 350 900 €

knownGaps.why: Genuine limitation. The property is 350 900 € (490.4 ZEC), the fees on the same page are 910 € to 2859€ (1.27 to 4.00 ZEC) — two and a half orders of magnitude, and the fees are a figure the buyer needs, not noise to be filtered out. French narrow-space grouping is read correctly. Holding the fees to the property's one decimal would print "1.3 ZEC" for a 910 € fee; holding the property to the fees' two would print "490.44 ZEC" and claim a fifth significant figure the rate cannot support.
